therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Asparagine depletion via encapsulated L-asparaginase enzyme
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Depletion of asparagine to starve leukemic cells that cannot synthesize this amino acid
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with relapsed acute lymphoblastic leukemia
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Duration of asparaginase activity >100 U/L and allergic reaction rate during induction

results.effect_size: Duration of activity: GRASPA 18.9 days (95% CI: 16.7-21.0) vs L-asparaginase 8.5 days (95% CI: 6.0-11.1); Allergic reactions: GRASPA 0 vs L-asparaginase 13
results.target_engagement_evidence: Asparaginase activity maintained >100 U/L for mean 18.9 days with GRASPA vs 8.5 days with native L-asparaginase
subgroup_findings: Non-allergic population: GRASPA showed superior duration of activity
Allergic population: GRASPA had 3 allergic reactions
results.dose_information: GRASPA: 150 IU/kg per cycle; L-asparaginase: 10000 IU/m² every 3 days (3-4 injections per cycle)

context.duration: 28 days induction period with 36 months follow-up
